Sentence splitting for claim decomposition breaks on every period, including those inside abbreviations and decimal numbers.
The exact-match metric strips all punctuation from the target string but not from the model's generated output before comparing them.

options.text: Normalize numeric strings and remove internal commas before tokenizing.
